nodes.label: Graceful Parse Error Handling (parseSafely)
nodes.rationale: Stores { parseError: true } with status 'failed' instead of retrying.

nodes.label: Partial Result Flagging
nodes.rationale: Pages that parse but lack the entity's identifying field are stored as status 'partial', counted as partial in scraper_jobs_total, and not URL-cached so they are retried later.

nodes.label: Job URL Validation (https LinkedIn, default port)
nodes.norm_label: job url validation (https linkedin, default port)

nodes.label: In-App Navigation Guard (defence in depth)
nodes.rationale: Aborts JS navigations leaving LinkedIn, popups, and requests to loopback/private/link-local/docker-internal hosts; blocked jobs fail without retries. Limits: Playwright interception misses HTTP 3xx redirect hops and its DNS check is separate from the browser's (DNS rebinding), so it is not the boundary.

nodes.label: Network Isolation via Browser Container (the real boundary)
nodes.norm_label: network isolation via browser container (the real boundary)
nodes.rationale: Separate network with no route to postgres/redis; kernel-level egress firewall checked per connection after DNS resolution covers 3xx redirects and DNS rebinding; drops root and all capabilities.

nodes.label: SSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: The worker drives a real browser, so job URLs must be https LinkedIn URLs on default port, and navigation is guarded in-app plus isolated at the network level.

nodes.label: Prometheus Metrics (scraper_jobs_total, block rate, duration, pool size)
nodes.norm_label: prometheus metrics (scraper_jobs_total, block rate, duration, pool size)

nodes.label: pixelscan jsModifyDetected Root Cause (top.MD5 missing)
nodes.rationale: fptc canvasHash/webglHash throw because pixelscan's MD5 isn't exposed globally, so the iframe fingerprint lacks keys and mismatches; proposed fix injects window.MD5 via addInitScript.

nodes.label: Persistent Context (Incognito Window fix)
nodes.rationale: Switched BrowserFactoryService to launchPersistentContext to fix the '(Incognito Window)' flag: real storage quota ~297 GB vs ephemeral ~1.3 GB.

nodes.label: Remote Mode Non-Persistent Context Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Remote mode uses a regular (non-persistent) browser context, so the Phase 2 persistent-profile Incognito Window mitigation only applies to local mode.

nodes.label: Compose Service: browser (SSRF boundary)
nodes.rationale: Chromium runs on a network without postgres/redis behind an egress firewall rejecting private/reserved destinations; NET_ADMIN only used by entrypoint before dropping to pwuser; not published to host. EGRESS_ALLOW permits IPv4:port exemptions e.g. a private proxy gateway.

nodes.label: CI Browser Isolation Job (egress firewall regression test)
nodes.norm_label: ci browser isolation job (egress firewall regression test)
nodes.rationale: Regression test for the SSRF boundary: builds the isolated browser image, starts it with the egress firewall, proves private destinations are rejected while the public internet stays reachable.

nodes.label: CI Test Job (lint, typecheck, test:cov, build)
nodes.norm_label: ci test job (lint, typecheck, test:cov, build)
nodes.rationale: Runs npm ci with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD since unit tests mock the browser; uploads coverage artifact; Node 22 matches Dockerfile build stage.

nodes.label: BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT
nodes.rationale: When unset, Chromium launches in-process with no isolation (dev only).

nodes.label: BROWSER_WS_TOKEN
nodes.rationale: Token-protects the browser websocket; generate with openssl rand -hex 24.

nodes.norm_label: legal notice (linkedin tos, gdpr, cfaa, robots.txt)

nodes.label: Tech Stack (NestJS, playwright-extra, BullMQ, TypeORM, Redis, cheerio)
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (nestjs, playwright-extra, bullmq, typeorm, redis, cheerio)

nodes.label: Coverage Gate (ratchet thresholds)
nodes.rationale: Global thresholds set at current floor (target 80%), stricter bar for src/scraper/security/; raise when coverage rises, never lower to pass a build; main.ts and *.module.ts excluded as DI wiring only.
